title: AgentRequest
description: One of the person's messages, as `chinwag test --agent-url` POSTs it to the agent's endpoint. This schema lists exactly what this version sends (additionalProperties is false so it stays exact); later versions may add optional fields, so an endpoint should ignore fields it does not know rather than validate requests strictly against this file.

conversationId.description: The conversation, as a phone number or chat would be: keep the history by it. In a test run it is "<platform>:<session>.<scenario>.<platform>.<run>", such as "whatsapp:ses_8f2a.opening-hours.whatsapp.1".

messageId.description: The id this message has in the conversation (m1, m2, ...): what a reply's `replyTo`, a reaction's `messageId` or a read's `messageIds` names.

channel.description: The platform the run plays (whatsapp, sms, imessage, telegram, web), or the name given with --channel.

text.description: What the person wrote; "" when they only sent a file (then it is the file's caption, if any).

replyTo.description: The message they replied to (theirs or the agent's), quoted.

fromAgent.description: true when the quoted message is the agent's.

choice.description: They tapped a button or picked a list row rather than typing.

id.description: The list row's id, when it has one.

attachments.description: Photos, voice notes and documents sent with the message.

name.description: The file name, when the platform gives one (documents).

data.description: The file's bytes, base64 (standard alphabet, with padding).
